mapper.select: SELECT fv.id, fv.uuid, fv.voucher_no AS voucherNo, fv.occurred_on AS occurredOn, fv.project_id AS projectId, fv.level_1_subject AS level1Subject, fv.level_2_subject AS level2Subject, fv.summary, fv.transaction_direction AS transactionDirection, fv.tax_rate AS taxRate, fv.counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, fv.counterparty_name_snapshot AS counterpartyNameSnapshot, fv.invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, fv.invoice_no AS invoiceNo, fv.invoice_amount AS invoiceAmount, fv.actual_income_amount AS actualIncomeAmount, fv.actual_expense_amount AS actualExpenseAmount, fv.booked_amount AS bookedAmount, fv.is_completed AS isCompleted, fv.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, fv.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, fv.remark, fv.created_at AS createdAt, fv.created_by AS createdBy, fv.updated_at AS updatedAt, fv.updated_by AS updatedBy FROM finance_voucher fv LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON fv.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON fv.auditor_user = au.id WHERE fv.uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT fv.id, fv.uuid, fv.voucher_no AS voucherNo, fv.occurred_on AS occurredOn, fv.project_id AS projectId, fv.level_1_subject AS level1Subject, fv.level_2_subject AS level2Subject, fv.summary, fv.transaction_direction AS transactionDirection, fv.tax_rate AS taxRate, fv.counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, fv.counterparty_name_snapshot AS counterpartyNameSnapshot, fv.invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, fv.invoice_no AS invoiceNo, fv.invoice_amount AS invoiceAmount, fv.actual_income_amount AS actualIncomeAmount, fv.actual_expense_amount AS actualExpenseAmount, fv.booked_amount AS bookedAmount, fv.is_completed AS isCompleted, fv.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, fv.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, fv.remark, fv.created_at AS createdAt, fv.created_by AS createdBy, fv.updated_at AS updatedAt, fv.updated_by AS updatedBy FROM finance_voucher fv LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON fv.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON fv.auditor_user = au.id WHERE fv.voucher_no = #{voucherNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT fv.id, fv.uuid, fv.voucher_no AS voucherNo, fv.occurred_on AS occurredOn, fv.project_id AS projectId, fv.level_1_subject AS level1Subject, fv.level_2_subject AS level2Subject, fv.summary, fv.transaction_direction AS transactionDirection, fv.tax_rate AS taxRate, fv.counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, fv.counterparty_name_snapshot AS counterpartyNameSnapshot, fv.invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, fv.invoice_no AS invoiceNo, fv.invoice_amount AS invoiceAmount, fv.actual_income_amount AS actualIncomeAmount, fv.actual_expense_amount AS actualExpenseAmount, fv.booked_amount AS bookedAmount, fv.is_completed AS isCompleted, fv.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, fv.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, fv.remark, fv.created_at AS createdAt, fv.created_by AS createdBy, fv.updated_at AS updatedAt, fv.updated_by AS updatedBy FROM finance_voucher fv LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON fv.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON fv.auditor_user = au.id ORDER BY fv.occurred_on DESC, fv.voucher_no DESC
SELECT MAX(CAST(RIGHT(voucher_no, 2) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM finance_voucher WHERE voucher_no LIKE CONCAT(#{monthPrefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_voucher ( uuid, voucher_no, occurred_on, project_id, level_1_subject, level_2_subject, summary, transaction_direction, tax_rate, counterparty_customer_id, counterparty_name_snapshot, invoice_status, invoice_no, invoice_amount, actual_income_amount, actual_expense_amount, booked_amount, is_completed, entry_user, auditor_user, remark, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{voucherNo}, #{occurredOn}, #{projectId}, #{level1Subject}, #{level2Subject}, #{summary}, #{transactionDirection}, #{taxRate}, #{counterpartyCustomerId}, #{counterpartyNameSnapshot}, #{invoiceStatus}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceAmount}, #{actualIncomeAmount}, #{actualExpenseAmount}, #{bookedAmount}, #{isCompleted}, #{entryUser}, #{auditorUser}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
